messages:
Elena: Quick update for Q4 spend: tight window ahead, please follow the guardrails below so month-end close isn't painful. :chart_with_downwards_trend:

Elena: 1) All project expenses must include Project Code and Cost Center in Concur. 2) Cardholders: reconcile receipts within 7 days of charge. 3) New vendor onboarding still needs the vendor form + tax W-9/Vendor W-8 when applicable.

Elena: If you expect a spend > $5k total for a project in Q4, open a vendor approval ticket so FP&A can provision budget. Link: <https://redwood.internal/finance/q4-spend|Q4 spend page>.

Omar: Quick Q 1: does the $5k threshold apply to bundled purchases (like 3 x $1.8k invoices)?

Elena: Yes. We aggregate expected recurring or one-off purchases toward the $5k review threshold. If it's predictable, submit now.

Jules: Any change to travel advance policy for conference travel?

Elena: No change to advances. Travel still requires manager pre-approval + Concur itinerary. Expensify/Concur coding unchanged.

Priya: For contractors: do we use the same vendor onboarding flow or is there a separate headcount/contractor process?

Elena: Contractors paid via vendor invoices need the vendor form. Contractor expenses billed on-line via employee expense reports follow normal Concur rules; make sure the right cost center is used.

FinanceBot: Reminder: Outstanding corporate card reconciliations: 12 people past 14 days. Please reconcile or your card may be suspended. (automated at 1796001350)

Omar: Noted, I cleared mine. Thanks FinanceBot.

Elena: Two small but important operational notes: a) Use "Q4-Freeze" tag on any purchases that must be locked for year-end. b) Procurement will not approve new vendor onboarding without completed security questionnaire for infra-related purchases.

Jules: Can we get a one-pager for managers that lists approval steps? I can push through manager slack channels.

Elena: On it. I'll publish a manager checklist and a short explainer doc by tomorrow and @PeopleOps will circulate.

Priya: Thanks, this helps. :thumbsup:

Elena: Thanks team. If you hit weird cases, DM me or @finance. We'll monitor tickets closely through next week.
